description: This file contains shell functions primarily for handling IPv4 addresses and network calculations, including validation, conversion, addressing range checks, and bitwise operations.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates that the input is a decimal number within the 32-bit unsigned integer range.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts a dotted decimal IPv4 address string into its 32-bit integer form.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer IPv4 address back into dotted decimal notation.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a prefix length (e.g., 24) into a subnet mask in 32-bit integer form.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IP address falls within RFC 1918 private address ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within the link-local range (RFC 3927).

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a multicast address.

methods.name: _is_contiguous
methods.description: Internal function to check if bits in a mask form a contiguous block.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Determines if the bits in a mask form a contiguous range.

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a subnet mask in 32-bit form to a prefix length, validating the mask's contiguity.
